Why mob and not the 0.9.27 tarball: the tree that used to be here was a partial
mob snapshot (mid Jul - early Sep 2026 file by file, labelled "0.9.27") with no
tcctools.c, include/ or lib/, so it could not be built into a working compiler.

C-OS specific changes to this tree: NONE to upstream files. C-OS-only files live
outside it (userland/programs/tcc/). This file records the provenance; to update,
re-import from upstream and change the commit line above.
